description: ELA Map draws your birth chart onto the Earth. Every planet sits on four lines around the globe, and astrocartography reads a place by the lines that run near it. Ask ELA Map whether a place you are considering sits on one of your lines, and it answers from your birth date, time and place, with a small map of that line. The answer is the geography; the reading lives on ELA Map, where all your lines are drawn on an interactive globe with plain-language readings, line crossings and location reports. No account is created inside ChatGPT, and the birth details you give are not stored.

defaultPrompt: Do any of my astrocartography lines run through Berlin? Born 11 Nov 1994, 11:11, Lisbon.
I was born 22 Sep 1985, 6:40 AM, Toronto. Are any of my astrocartography lines near Tokyo?
Show my astrocartography lines. Born 3 March 1990 in Sydney, Australia; I don't know the time.
